What's the best way to keep Deer out of my vegetable garden?

For mine, I put a netwrap fence on poles around the garden at about chest height, then hung a few aluminum pie tins from the poles. They don't know what to make of it, so they don't try to go over it.

Get some metal wire fencing (the stuff with square openings a few inches by a few inches) and lay it flat a few inches off the ground. Deer get their feet caught in it and learn to avoid it. (picture kids trying to run through tires) Alternately, you can install two 5' tall fences spaced 5' apart. Deer can jump high or wide but not both. They also won't jump into something that they're not sure they can get out of, so a fence that's only around a raised bed can work. Another possible solution is to spread predator urine around the area but you have to renew it every couple days. If you are or live with a meat-eating man then just ask him to pee around (but not on) your garden. Fencing is the surest bet though.
